title: ⚠️ HEB ISD phones can't receive outside calls on Sept. 25
text:
1 days ago ⚠️ HEB ISD phone lines down for outside calls today
As of September 25, 2026 , HEB ISD’s phone system provider is having a partial outage .
Right now, schools and district offices cannot receive calls from outside phone lines . There is no estimated repair time yet.
If you’re trying to reach an HEB ISD school or employee , please:
Try calling again later today , and For urgent questions, send an email instead. Internet and email are working, and staff also have access to their personal cell phones.
To find an email address:
Go to your school’s website , Open the Teachers & Staff menu, then Use the page that lists Administrators and Front Office staff to email the person who can best help you. District school websites are linked from the HEB ISD Schools page on the district site.
